title: System Design Case Studies
intro: System design cases are the concrete interview problems that apply the system-design primitives. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with URL shortener (the classic warm-up), then rate limiter, then the communication systems (chat, notification) that test real-time design. Search autocomplete and social media feed are the scale tier, then payment system — the hardest because it adds idempotency and consistency. It closes with scenario-based variants.
